sources.scope: Bounded Qwen3.5/Qwen3-Next caller, GDN phase/architecture policy, separate conv wrappers and state metadata; no native execution or external kernel equivalence.

applicability: Separate causal-conv phase/layout/state contracts and conditional one-shot classification-prefill transfer

findings.direction: Use one backend label for both convolution and recurrence
findings.reason: A prefill flag does not replace both operators; equating an explicit flag, package availability or a registered symbol with executed dispatch misreads the source, and sm89 compatibility cannot be claimed from an SM9/10 automatic default
findings.revisit_when: Read the backend aliases/policy and the ordinary decode path separately before naming a dispatch

findings.direction: Infer strides from shape for the Triton prefill path
findings.reason: CUDA input can select stride-aware Triton prefill; assuming unconditional input aliasing or no mutation, letting packed requests read each other's history, or assuming the conv mask clears the recurrent matrix are all source misreadings
findings.revisit_when: Check the prefill caller, SRT wrapper and Triton wrapper for the actual stride and mutation contract

findings.direction: Reuse batch index as persistent identity across reordered rows
findings.reason: Equating temporal state with attention KV, losing gather/scatter write-back, or treating a successful output computation as proof that continuation, reset or recycling is correct all break the state contract
findings.revisit_when: Trace mapping/ownership and the state gather and write-back paths; both state writes must be kept

findings.direction: Treat fresh classification prefill as decode or multi-item scoring
findings.reason: Presenting source reasoning or packaged reads as a binding, native test, quality pass or service gain confuses the evidence level; a generic classifier is not MIS, and unused returned cache does not make internal state writes dispensable
findings.revisit_when: Read the MIS constraints before classifying a prefill path; keep source reasoning distinct from a native result

limitations: Native kernels, models and devices not_run
No HF binding, sm89/backend qualification, numerical/model-quality or performance claim
Whole reset/cancellation/radix eviction, speculative and ReplaySSM lifecycles outside this readset
